newsitem.title: USA: Saks August same-store sales rise 11.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Saks August same-store sales rise 11.8 pct.

text.p: NOTE: Figures in millions except percentage.
Month is August weeks ended August 31 .
Full company name is Saks Holdings Inc
Saks said it could not compare 1996 and 1995 fiscal periods because 1995 had 53 weeks.
On a fiscal basis, total sales for the four weeks ended August 31, 1996 rose 17.5 percent, while same store sales rose 13.2 percent during the four weeks ended August 26, 1995, it said.
On a fiscal basis, total sales for the 30 weeks ended August 31, 1996 rose 17.7 percent and comparable sales rose 12.9 percent during the 30 weeks ended August 26, 1995, it said.
